launchctl setenv EDITOR 'zed --wait' launchctl setenv GOPRIVATE github.com/devrev launchctl setenv COLIMA_HOME $XDG_CONFIG_HOME/colima
launchctl setenv ARCUS_API_KEY $(/usr/bin/security find-generic-password -a devrev -s arcus-token -w) launchctl setenv DEVREV_API_KEY $(/usr/bin/security find-generic-password -a devrev -s devrev-token -w)
